text1: A rare and ancient hull which possesses unusually advanced technology for its age. Its history is shrouded in secrecy, but it is said to have once been used by a brotherhood of genetically enhanced warriors known only as the Angels of Death.

This ship has been given Luddic Church markings, and certain heretical technologies have been stripped out.

An ancient and reliable multi-purpose space/aircraft that's built like a tank and armed like one too, with a modified Heavy Mauler mounted on top. It was originally designed for spec-ops troop insertion and ground support, but it can more than hold its own in space combat.

A smaller, more primitive version of the Hellbore. The manual operation of a Macrocannon is a difficult and dangerous affair, the machinery is often etched with the names of those unfortunate crew members who were crushed in the process.
An advanced weapon system designed to punch through armor plating at long-range. Has a low rate of fire but high per-shot damage.

The miner's best friend, this weapon can deliver a pulverizing bolt of energy at close range. The ore scanner is repurposed as an interlock to prevent excessive use against shields when the weapon is in autofire mode.
